title: Portable Driver Triage — index.jsonl row
description: One JSON document per line in reports/index.jsonl. Represents a single analysis run (sha256 × scope × run_id), append-only, never mutated. Readers deduplicate by (identity.sha256, run.scope_profile) and pick the most recent run.generated_at.

schema_version.description: Row schema version. Pipeline upgrades bump this; readers may skip or down-convert older rows during a migration window.

identity.description: Facts that depend only on the binary. Repeated across all analyses of the same sha256 so rows stay self-contained.

tlsh.description: Null is legitimate — TLSH fails on small inputs.

driver_file.description: Original filename of the .sys as extracted from the installer.

product.description: From PE VS_VERSION_INFO. Null when absent (not empty string).

vendor.description: From PE VS_VERSION_INFO. Null when absent.

file_version.description: From PE VS_VERSION_INFO. Null when absent.

signature_status.description: Status at the moment of collection. `was-valid-ever` is NOT a status — it is a filter flag applied at L0, see run.flags.signature.

signer.description: Leaf signer name, informational. Null when unsigned or unresolvable.

run.description: Metadata of this specific analysis run.

scope_profile.description: Name of a scope profile under scope_profiles/.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, must end with Z.

flags.description: Flags that affected interpretation. Documented keys below; additional keys allowed as the pipeline evolves.

signature.description: L0 signature filter policy chosen for this run.

clone_ref.description: Reference set used for clone detection, e.g. 'loldrivers@2026-09-15'.

l3_mode.description: Whether L3 decompilation ran in deep (per-function pseudo-C) or shallow (handler summaries only) mode.

bundle_path.description: Relative to the project root, always ends with /.

signals.description: Triage-ready signals. Split by whether they depend on the active scope profile.

scope_independent.description: Computed in L1 regardless of the active scope. These are what let Mode C triage questions find candidates across the whole corpus, even when individual rows were produced under a different scope.

ioctl_methods.description: All four keys always present (0 when the method is absent) so query predicates are predictable.

device_names.description: Device objects created or referenced by the driver (e.g., \\Device\\OcDriver).

device_classes.description: Closed vocabulary. New classes require a schema_version bump.

interesting_strings.description: Hits from refs/interesting_strings.yaml — meaningful substrings found in the binary.

ref_id.description: Identifier in the known-vulnerable reference set.

cve.description: Null when the referenced driver has no public CVE.

scope_matches.description: All scope profiles whose baseline fingerprint matches this driver, with the rank computed from each profile's rank_weights. This is what makes cross-scope triage possible.

scope_dependent.description: Deep-analysis facts for THIS run's scope only. Always present; counts may be zero if the gate filtered everything.

rank.description: Rank for run.scope_profile. Redundant with the matching scope_matches entry on purpose, for direct querying.

top_handler.description: Highest-ranked handler. Null when no handler survived the function gate.

evidence_pointers.description: Relative paths (from project root) to the key artifacts of this bundle. findings_json / findings_md are written here by the AI; the paths are pre-filled so the AI knows exactly where to drop them.

findings_json.description: Path where the AI's findings.json will be written. May not exist on disk yet.

findings_md.description: Path where the AI's findings.md will be written. May not exist on disk yet.

top_findings_preview.description: Preview of the AI's own findings for this bundle, if findings.json exists. Null when the AI has not yet analyzed this bundle. Lets a Mode C triage AI see the verdict of a previous deep pass without opening findings.json.
